data.one_liner: A flexible Flutter candlestick chart framework for stock and crypto markets.
data.what_it_does: FlexiKline is a comprehensive candlestick chart framework providing pluggable indicators, drawing tools, custom styles, and gesture handling for financial markets. It supports main and sub panes, computed or direct indicators, and runs across Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
use_when: You need to build a professional stock or cryptocurrency trading interface in Flutter.
You require customizable candlestick charts with drawing tools and technical indicators like MA and MACD.
You need high-performance rendering capable of handling real-time WebSocket price updates.
avoid_when: You only need basic general-purpose charts like simple line, bar, or pie charts.
You want a zero-configuration, plug-and-play chart without managing indicator pipelines or configs.
strengths: Extensive framework with pluggable indicators, drawing tools, and styles.
Decoupled calculation and painting layers with strong performance benchmarks.
Rich gesture support including pan, pinch zoom, crosshair, and price-axis scaling.
weaknesses: Requires significant setup and configuration code compared to basic chart packages.
Steeper learning curve due to the separation of controllers, configurations, and indicators.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and configure Flutter SDK >= 3.41.0.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick fl_chart if you need general-purpose, easy-to-use line, bar, and pie charts rather than specialized financial K-line charts.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick syncfusion_flutter_charts if you want a commercially supported, feature-rich charting library with built-in financial chart types.
